novelty_basis: Elementary consequences of the CRT and of classical facts on polynomial congruences; the reduction of identities to conditions on affine (linear) representations is standard for quasigroups and medial magmas (Toyoda-Bruck). Recorded as the lab's tool, not as new mathematics.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C13.md Theorem 1; Chinese remainder theorem, Bezout in Q[a], Gauss's lemma, Schur's theorem); consistent with all 152 spectra of EXP-C13-01 (every finite one is Div(L)); awaiting independent skeptic review
statement:
For any finite set E of laws, the anchored affine tables are exactly x*y = x + a*y + 1, and the affine spectrum
Aff(E) is the set of N for which the affine system of E (polynomials in Z[a]) has a common root mod N. Aff(E) is
closed under divisors and under coprime products; if the system has no common factor over Q it is finite and
equal to the set of divisors of its maximum L (which divides a resultant of the system), and otherwise it is
infinite.
title: Affine anchored spectra are root sets of polynomial systems - divisor-closed, CRT-closed, finite ones are divisor sets
